n800d548f9f.headline: Ibex-35 closes negative in a session of profit-taking
n800d548f9f.summary: The Ibex-35 index ended Monday's session in negative territory following a rebound on Friday, with profit-taking and selective buying amid ongoing uncertainty.
n800d548f9f.why: The Ibex-35 is a key benchmark for the Spanish stock market, reflecting investor sentiment and economic conditions in Spain.

impacts.name: Ibex-35
impacts.why: Profit-taking and uncertainty caused index decline.
